THE TEXTS OF THE WHITE YAJURVEDA

OR VâJASANEYA-SAMHITâ.

BOOK THE FIRST.

1 For food thee, for strength thee! Ye are winds, ye are approachers.

2 Strainer of Vasu art thou. Thou art heaven, thou art earth.

3 Strainer of Vasu art thou, hundred-streamed; strainer of Vasu art thou, thousand-streamed.
